item.content:encoded: Battery Metals and Critical Minerals Summit South Africa 2025 | ICS2025
item.excerpt:encoded: Join ICS2025 in Cape Town to connect with lithium, cobalt, rare earth, and critical mineral leaders. Secure supply chain positions before they’re gone.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Critical Metals Expo Cobalt Conference International Commodity Summit 2025 – Cape Town November 17–20, 2025 Cape Town International Convention Centre The Supply Chain Is Being Rebuilt Without You Global battery manufacturers, energy companies, and automakers are scrambling to secure lithium, cobalt, rare earths, and nickel. ICS2025 is where the supply chain is being mapped, monetized, and locked in. Don’t miss your chance to get embedded before it’s too late. Cape Town Is the Deal Room South Africa's ICS2025 brings producers, investors, policymakers, and buyers together. From Zimbabwe lithium to DRC cobalt, Cape Town is the only place where the global battery mineral value chain aligns in real-time. Why Attend? Secure long-term offtake agreements Meet regulators and ESG advisors Connect with mining CEOs, fund managers, and tech buyers Join critical sessions on resource security and export strategy Event Details When: 17–20 November 2025 Where: Cape Town International Convention Centre Tracks: Battery Metals, Critical Minerals, Dealmaking, ESG Strategy Register Now
